{{Top|leg}}
'''Rebel Alliance foster homes''' were foster homes located on [[Safe world/Legends|Rebel safeworlds]] that were run under the protection of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They took in orphans who were victims of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
